title: The Somatic Framework WordPress plugin through 1.8.14 does not perform an authorization check or validate a…
description: The Somatic Framework WordPress plugin versions up to 1.8.14 contain a vulnerability where no authorization check or validation of user-supplied file paths is performed before deleting files. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including low-privileged roles such as subscribers, to delete arbitrary files on the server. Exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to a full site takeover.
